question.text: Rising interest rates affect option premiums as follows:

answer.text: Call premium increases, Put premium decreases
Both call and put premiums increase
Call premium decreases, Put premium increases

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook table (and reinforced in the sample question), a rise in interest rates causes the call premium to rise and the put premium to fall. The Trap: Interest rates move call and put premiums in opposite directions, not the same direction as volatility does. Note: This is one of the standard pricing factors documented alongside underlying price, strike, time to expiry, and volatility.
